Resolve a color mapping for group names

Source: R/common-fun-colors.R
dot-resolve_group_colors.Rd

Builds a named color vector for group_names, resolving colors_vec by name wherever possible so each color maps to its intended group regardless of the order or length of the inputs.

Usage

.resolve_group_colors(group_names_requested, group_names, colors_vec = NULL)

Arguments

group_names_requested

character vector of group names in their originally requested order, used to pair an unnamed colors_vec by name; NULL if no group_names were requested. Duplicates are ignored (the first occurrence wins).

group_names

character vector (no duplicates) of group names to produce a color for, in their required order

colors_vec

character vector of colors (name or hex value). If fully named (e.g. c(cell_DC = "blue")), matched to group_names by name, independent of order; otherwise matched positionally against group_names_requested (partial naming is treated as unnamed). Invalid, missing, or extra entries fall back to the default palette (get_qual_colors); nothing is recycled.

Value

named character vector of colors, one per entry of group_names

Author

Janina Smoła janina.smola@external.roche.com

Examples

# \donttest{
gDRplots:::.resolve_group_colors(
 group_names_requested = c("cell_DC", "cell_XY", "cell_AB"),
 group_names = c("cell_AB", "cell_DC", "cell_XY"),
 colors_vec = c("blue", "red", "grey"))
#> cell_AB cell_DC cell_XY 
#>  "grey"  "blue"   "red" 

gDRplots:::.resolve_group_colors(
 group_names_requested = c("cell_DC", "cell_XY", "cell_AB"),
 group_names = c("cell_AB", "cell_DC", "cell_XY"),
 colors_vec = c(cell_DC = "blue", cell_XY = "red", cell_AB = "grey"))
#> cell_AB cell_DC cell_XY 
#>  "grey"  "blue"   "red" 

# missing entries fall back to the default palette
gDRplots:::.resolve_group_colors(
 group_names_requested = c("cell_DC", "cell_XY", "cell_AB"),
 group_names = c("cell_AB", "cell_DC", "cell_XY"),
 colors_vec = c("blue", "red"))
#>   cell_AB   cell_DC   cell_XY 
#> "#1B9E77"    "blue"     "red" 

# partial naming is treated as unnamed
gDRplots:::.resolve_group_colors(
 group_names_requested = c("cell_DC", "cell_XY", "cell_AB"),
 group_names = c("cell_AB", "cell_DC", "cell_XY"),
 colors_vec = c(cell_AB = "grey", "blue", "red"))
#> Warning: 'colors_vec' has some, but not all, elements named - names are ignored and colors are matched to requested group_names by position instead.
#> cell_AB cell_DC cell_XY 
#>   "red"  "grey"  "blue" 
# }
